notes: Examined registry outcomeMeasuresModule and adverseEventsModule seriousEvents and otherEvents. The outcome measures concern cardiovascular and renal composites, not hypoglycemia. The otherEvents term "Hypoglycaemia" is a non-serious adverse-event entry reported with a 5% frequency threshold; it is a different quantity from patients with 1 or more episodes of hypoglycemia of all severities. Serious-event entries also do not represent this all-severity outcome. Counts and arm ownership are witnessed in the trial report abstract in doc_ft_30418475.txt; denominators are explicitly printed in its Interventions section. All four counts match row.json.served.
